notes.title: 60 fps patch 1.0.0.20
notes.content:
Last time I played my game I felt pain in my ass. 30 fps is disgusting today.
Game is now 60 fps and I feel like now it looks the way I really want it to look.
*tons of changes but 95% of them refers to fps changes
*boss Heart of Evil nerfed

tags.feature: Game is now 60 fps and I feel like now it looks the way I really want it to look.

tags.balance_change: *boss Heart of Evil nerfed

notes.content:
balance:
* reduced resistances for Big Head boss
* reduced resistances for Mirana boss
* reduced hp and resistances for Heart of Evil boss
* reduced prices in shop for buying things and upgrades
bugs:

* fixed wrong sounds for some atacks 
* fixed issue that ice block can stuck character when water freezed

notes.title: Shadow run
notes.content:
*new ability - shadow run. It makes game much easier but more fun. It allows to run faster to avoid bullets or enemies and jump further
Shadow run activates when holding SHIFT(keyboard) or B(gamepad). Shadow run uses stamina
[b]Balance[/b]
*new sounds for swords and bows
*stamina generation increased
*reduced resistances for nest-like mobs. 
*several notes added to starting level
*cutscene is much faster in starting level
*Blacksmith is now interactable with E(keyboard)
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
*fixed bugs when using bow
*fixed bugs in starting level
* some other small fixes


I'll try to make some new things later
